title: Airborne measurements of peroxyacetyl nitric anhydride (PAN) and peroxyacetic acid (PAA) over the Amazon rainforest: the role of isoprene and the fate of the peroxyacetyl radical
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, 6,687-702
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00169B, Paper
Open Access

Carolina Nelson, Matthias Kohl, Sergey Gromov, Andrea Pozzer, Simone T. Andersen, Raphael Dörich, Jos Lelieveld, John N. Crowley
PAN (CH3C(O)O2NO2) and PAA (CH3C(O)OOH) are formed in the atmosphere uniquely and competitively from the same precursor radical (CH3C(O)O2), whereby the relative rates of formation of PAN and PAA are determined by the abundances of HO2 and NO2.
